frequency_question: What proportion of major statutory bills clear the necessary committee referral, floor scheduling, debate limits, and final vote sequence within a 307-day operational window?
membership_rule: Includes any standalone legislative bill introduced in the Senate or received from the House requiring multiple committee steps and floor votes; excludes unanimous consent resolutions and must-pass appropriations.

cases.name: Border Security and Immigration Act attempts
Freedom to Vote Act cloture attempts
National Defense Authorization Act annual cycles

coverage_note: 5 major legislative paths examined; representative of contested statutory requirements.
known_gaps: Does not account for special fast-track rules like reconciliation which do not apply here.
skeleton: Legislative process steps: Committee referral (14-45 days), markup/report (30-90 days), leadership floor scheduling (14-120 days), cloture motion and waiting period (2-7 days), debate and amendments (3-14 days), final passage vote (1 day). Minimum sequential path under full cooperation is roughly 65 days; median contested path exceeds 300 days.
multiplier: 5 historical reference items evaluated for duration fit within a 307-day ceiling
validity_reason: Senate standing rules and procedural timelines remain stable across multiple Congresses unless the filibuster rule is explicitly altered.
